# SGD2FreeRes -- patch carrier, NOT a reimplementation module.
#
# Mirrors source/D2Client/CMakeLists.txt. The target hosts the shadow-dispatch
# conformance machinery (SGD2FreeRes_ShadowDispatch.gen.h, generated by
# conformance/tools/gen_shadow_dispatch.py from
# conformance/shadow_manifest.SGD2FreeRes.json) via SGD2FreeRes.patch.cpp, which
# D2MOO_register_D2_DLL_patches() attaches automatically once "SGD2FreeRes" is
# in D2_KNOWN_DLLS (cmake/D2MOO.ModHelpers.cmake).
#
# FIRST NON-D2 TARGET HERE. Every other entry is one of Diablo II's own DLLs,
# but nothing in D2.Detours is D2-specific -- D2DetoursRegisterPatchFolder
# enumerates *.dll in the patch folder and registers each by FILENAME, so a
# patch DLL named SGD2FreeRes.dll is applied to the module of that name. The
# fixed list was a build-time convenience, not a constraint.
#
# It is loaded ALONGSIDE the real SGD2FreeRes.dll as a patch, never as a
# drop-in replacement -- the same model as D2Client's and D2Common's carriers.
add_library(SGD2FreeRes SHARED
  src/SGD2FreeRes.cpp
)
D2MOO_configure_exports(SGD2FreeRes IGNORE_MISSING_DEF)
# Header-only (INTERFACE lib) -- D2_VERSION_113C / D2_MAYBE_UNUSED for
# SGD2FreeRes.patch.cpp, matching every other patch module's convention.
target_link_libraries(SGD2FreeRes PRIVATE D2CommonDefinitions)
